stories.title: Show HN: Replacing CAPTCHAs with adaptive proof-of-work in WordPress
summary: When I founded my business a whistle-blowing-service for enterprises, I’ve seeked for a working solution to block spam bots on that home page.

The solution was intended to comply with EU data privacy law, no cookies, no sniffing, light-weight-size, on my webserver only, beeing invisible for my site visitors and no running costs at all.I came across Hashcash, a proof-of-work approach, to block spam.

Therefore I‘ve turned it into a free wordpress-plugin.It is not only a technical solution, but starts with the business model of spam (mass spamming at low cost), by producing a calculation effort for every single post, that unavoidable.
